reason: no_reward. Pangolin V2 on Avalanche is a vanilla Uniswap V2 fork (factory 0xefa94DE7a4656D787667C749f7E1223D71E9FD88, 3660 pairs) plus a MasterChef staking layer. No function anyone can call pays the caller a keeper/bounty reward: factory createPair (open) and pair mint/burn/swap/skim/sync pay only the caller's own LP value or skim dust, and chef harvest pays a staker their own accrued PNG (0 to a stranger with no stake). Earning here means providing liquidity and staking, not acting as a keeper.
